description: This file defines classes and structures related to Metal buffer management in the ANGLE graphics project, including BufferMtl, buffer conversion structures, and buffer holder classes.

classes.name: ConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Holds translated index and vertex data buffers with a dirty flag.

classes.name: IndexConversionBufferMtl
classes.description: Extends ConversionBufferMtl with index type and offset, plus converted buffer references.

classes.name: BufferHolderMtl
classes.description: Abstract class managing current Metal buffer references, handling synchronization between CPU and GPU.

classes.name: BufferMtl
classes.description: Implements Buffer interface for Metal buffers, managing data setting, mapping, copying, and conversion buffers.

classes.name: VertexConversionBuffer
classes.description: Caches vertex data conversions identified by format, stride, and offset.

classes.name: SimpleWeakBufferHolderMtl
classes.description: Concrete class for weak buffer references, allowing setting of buffers.

methods.name: getCurrentBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current Metal buffer, considering weak references.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets data in the buffer with specified target and usage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a given offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from a source buffer to this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer after CPU access.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing.

methods.name: getFirstLastIndices
methods.description: Gets the first and last indices in the buffer.

methods.name: getClientShadowCopyData
methods.description: Returns a shadow copy of the buffer data.

methods.name: getVertexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex conversion buffer.

methods.name: getIndexConversionBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an index conversion buffer.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the buffer reference in SimpleWeakBufferHolderMtl.
